## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to assert RCC-8 Tangential Proper Part — a region is a proper part sharing boundary; a specialization of [`gmeow:containedInLocation`](gmeow-containedInLocation.md) / [`gmeow:partOf`](gmeow-partOf.md), inverse of [`gmeow:rcc8tppi`](gmeow-rcc8tppi.md).

### Avoid when

- Avoid it for non-tangential containment ([`gmeow:rcc8ntpp`](gmeow-rcc8ntpp.md)) or equality ([`gmeow:rcc8eq`](gmeow-rcc8eq.md)).

### How to use

- Assert exactly one RCC-8 relation per region pair; TPP feeds the containment/part spine.
